QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] The Absent Pentacle
QuestInfo.0: What does the spellbook say? Talk to Beatrice.
QuestInfo.1: The spellbook says something about a pentacle, but you haven't seen any pentacles in Kritias. Beatrice has an idea, though. \r\nEliminate #bPermeating Solitudes, Permeating Terrors, Permeating Angers, Permeating Anxieties, and Permeating Vanities#k in the #bForest of Sorrows#k and collect #bTower Fragments#k.
QuestInfo.2: You collected all the Tower Fragments. What will Beatrice have to say?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#

Can proceed to [Kritias] A Question of Scale

0.0: Interesting. This spellbook makes many references to a pentacle. A rather powerful one. \r\n#L0##bI haven't seen any pentacles around Kritias, though.#l\n#k
0.1: Indeed. I've seen hexes, bedazzlements, and a cross-eyed pixie, but no pentacles... Unless...\r\n#L0##bUnless?#l\n#k
0.2: It can't be. Could it? #h0#, would you be a dear and bring me some #bTower Fragments#k from outside of town?

yes.0: The #bPermeating#k monsters in the #bForest of Sorrows#k have probably picked up fragments from the castle walls. I'll need, say, #b10 Tower Fragments#k to confirm my theory.

no.0: I'm sure you have plenty of other things to do, but if I'm right, well... You're missing out on a VERY big reveal!

1.0: It's a shame to see the castle in this state.

yes.0: Good, they still have some magical resonance left. Let me get my mystical magnifying glass...

item.0: Defeat #bPermeating#k monsters in the #bForest of Sorrows#k and bring me #b10 Tower Fragments#k.
